ticker_news.title: Got $1,000? A Top Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Is On Sale Right Now
ticker_news.description: ASML, a critical company in the chip value chain, has seen its stock price drop around 40% from its all-time high due to reduced guidance for 2025. While this is a short-term headwind, the long-term trends for ASML remain strong as the need for more chip capacity continues to grow.
ticker_news.author: Keithen Drury

ticker_news.title: The Future of AI PC: Market Segmentation, Growth Projections, Opportunities and Forecast to 2030
ticker_news.description: The AI PC market is projected to grow from $50.61 billion in 2024 to $231.30 billion by 2030, driven by the integration of high-processing NPUs and growing demand for AI-based gaming PCs. Asia Pacific is expected to see the highest CAGR, while desktops/notebooks and Windows OS are expected to dominate the market.
ticker_news.author: Globe Newswire

ticker_news.title: Microchip to Accelerate Real-time Edge AI with NVIDIA Holoscan
ticker_news.description: Microchip Technology has released its PolarFire® FPGA Ethernet Sensor Bridge, which works with the NVIDIA Holoscan sensor processing platform. The platform enables developers to create innovative, real-time solutions for AI-driven edge applications in various industries.
ticker_news.author: Microchip Technology

ticker_news.title: The INX Digital Company Reports Q3 2024 Financial Results
ticker_news.description: The INX Digital Company reported its Q3 2024 financial results, highlighting a strong balance sheet, strategic partnerships, and U.S. expansion. The company maintained a reserve fund and reduced operational losses compared to the previous year.
ticker_news.author: Prnewswire

ticker_news.title: 1 Wall Street Analyst Thinks Nvidia Stock Is Going to $178. Is It a Buy?
ticker_news.description: Nvidia's stock is nearing new highs ahead of its upcoming earnings report, but one analyst believes investors should wait until after the report to decide whether to buy the shares. The article discusses Nvidia's strong data center performance and the potential for volatility around earnings releases.
ticker_news.author: John Ballard

ticker_news.title: Is Coca-Cola a Buy, Sell, or Hold in 2025?
ticker_news.description: The article discusses the challenges facing Coca-Cola, including slowing revenue growth, declining operating margins, and a weak outlook for the broader soda industry. The author believes Coca-Cola's stock is not an attractive investment compared to other options and rates it a sell for 2025.
ticker_news.author: David Butler

SPY.title: US Futures Marginally Up As Investors Process Inflation Data Ahead Of Jerome Powell's Speech On Economy: Expert Says Fed Should 'Continue Recalibrating To Neutral' On Softer Inflation
SPY.description: US stock futures are slightly up as investors digest the latest inflation data and await Fed Chair Jerome Powell's speech on the economic outlook. Experts suggest the Fed should continue recalibrating policy as inflation softens.
SPY.author: Rounak Jain
